title: Website Packages in Kenya: Starter, Business, Commerce and Custom Compared
title_sw: Vifurushi vya Tovuti Kenya: Starter, Business, Commerce na Custom Vinavyolinganishwa
excerpt: A plain comparison of four website packages in Kenya, what each one is for, and how to choose without overpaying.

content:
## Start with the job, not the price

Many business owners ask for the cheapest website. The better question is what the website must do for the business. A restaurant that wants a phone number and a menu does not need the same build as a shop taking orders, or a company running internal workflows.

Below is a plain comparison of the four website packages offered by Thomas Hondo Chacha. Prices are shown in Kenyan shillings and are confirmed starting prices. The right package is the smallest one that does the job well.

## Starter — from KSh 25,000

Starter is for a business that needs a clean, credible online presence. Think of a salon, a small hotel, a consultant, or a local service provider whose main goal is to be found and contacted.

It suits you when you need a simple site that explains who you are, what you offer, where you are, and how to reach you. If your customer only needs a phone number, a WhatsApp link, and a short service list, this is usually enough.

Do not buy Starter if you need online payments, customer accounts, bookings, or a catalogue that changes every day. That is not a weakness in the package. It is a scope decision.

## Business — from KSh 55,000

Business is for a company that has outgrown a brochure site. It fits businesses with several services, multiple locations, a blog, or a stronger need to explain their process before a customer calls.

This is the package to consider when your website must do more than answer who, what and where. It should answer why you, show proof of work, and guide a visitor toward a quote. If you already have useful content but it is scattered across social media, a Business site gives it a permanent home.

## Commerce — from KSh 120,000

Commerce is for selling online. It covers the extra work that turns a website into a shop: product structure, order flow, and the practical details that decide whether a customer can complete a purchase.

Choose Commerce when you are serious about online orders and you have someone who can prepare product information, prices, and delivery details. A shop without clear product data will struggle no matter how good the design is.

Before ordering, write down how you take payments, how you deliver, and what happens when an order is cancelled. Those answers shape the build.

## Custom — from KSh 150,000

Custom is for work that is not a website in the usual sense. It fits internal tools, customer portals, reporting dashboards, API integrations, and workflows that a template cannot handle.

This package starts with discovery. The first deliverable is a clear specification, not code. That protects both sides: you know what is being built, and the developer knows what success looks like.

If two or more people in your business will use the same system to do the same task every week, a custom web application may be cheaper than years of manual work.

## What stays the same across packages

Every engagement starts with a written proposal and an agreed scope. You should know what you are paying for before work begins. Revisions, content supply, and third-party costs should be stated clearly.

Payment is handled per issue. There is no automatic debit and no automatic unlock flow. Details for Buy Goods, bank transfer, and Send Money are provided on the payment page.

## How to choose in one minute

Write one sentence: This website must help ______ do ______.

If the sentence ends with contact me, start with Starter. If it ends with understand and request a quote, look at Business. If it ends with buy and receive an order, look at Commerce. If it ends with manage a process, look at Custom.

## Next step

Use the Start a project button on this site, or send a WhatsApp message to 0705 023 432 with your one-sentence goal. You will get a clear recommendation, not a hard sell.

## Anza na kazi, si bei

Wengi huuliza tovuti ya bei rahisi zaidi. Swali bora ni: tovuti hii itafanya nini kwa biashara? Mgahawa unaotaka namba na menyu hauhitaji kazi ile ile na duka linalopokea oda, au kampuni inayoendesha kazi za ndani.

Hapa kuna ulinganisho rahisi wa vifurushi vinne vya tovuti vinavyotolewa na Thomas Hondo Chacha. Bei zinaonyeshwa kwa shilingi za Kenya na ni bei za kuanzia zilizothibitishwa. Kifurushi sahihi ni kidogo kinachokamilisha kazi vizuri.

## Starter — kuanzia KSh 25,000

Starter ni kwa biashara inayohitaji uwepo mtandaoni safi na wa kuaminika. Fikiria salon, hoteli ndogo, mshauri, au mtoa huduma wa eneo ambaye lengo lake kuu ni kupatikana na kuwasiliana.

Inakufaa unapohitaji tovuti rahisi inayoeleza wewe ni nani, unatoa nini, uko wapi, na jinsi ya kufikia. Ikiwa mteja anahitaji tu namba, kiungo cha WhatsApp, na orodha fupi ya huduma, hii inatosha.

Usichague Starter ikiwa unahitaji malipo mtandaoni, akaunti za wateja, kuweka miadi, au orodha inayobadilika kila siku. Hiyo sio dosari ya kifurushi. Ni uamuzi wa upeo wa kazi.

## Business — kuanzia KSh 55,000

Business ni kwa kampuni iliyokua zaidi ya tovuti ya matangazo. Inafaa biashara zenye huduma nyingi, maeneo mbalimbali, blog, au hitaji kubwa la kueleza mchakato kabla mteja atupige simu.

Hii ni kifurushi cha kuzingatia wakati tovuti lazima ifanye zaidi ya kujibu nani, nini na wapi. Inapaswa kujibu kwa nini wewe, kuonyesha uthibitisho wa kazi, na kumwelekeza mgeni kwenye ombi la bei.

## Commerce — kuanzia KSh 120,000

Commerce ni kwa kuuza mtandaoni. Inajumuisha kazi ya ziada inayogeuza tovuti kuwa duka: muundo wa bidhaa, mtiririko wa oda, na maelezo ya vitendo yanayoamua kama mteja anaweza kumaliza ununuzi.

Chagua Commerce wakati umeamua kufanya oda mtandaoni na una mtu anayeweza kuandaa taarifa za bidhaa, bei, na maelezo ya utoaji. Duka bila taarifa wazi za bidhaa litakwenda vibaya hata muundo ukiwa mzuri.

Kabla ya kuagiza, andika jinsi unavyopokea malipo, jinsi unavyotoa bidhaa, na nini kinatokea oda likighairiwa. Majibu hayo yanaunda kazi.

## Custom — kuanzia KSh 150,000

Custom ni kwa kazi isiyo tovuti ya kawaida. Inafaa zana za ndani, lango la wateja, dashibodi za ripoti, ujumuishaji wa API, na mtiririko ambao templeti haiwezi kushughulikia.

Kifurushi hiki huanza na ugunduzi. Toa la kwanza ni vipimo wazi, si kodi. Hiyo inalinda pande zote: unajua kinachojengwa, na msanidi anajua mafanikio yanaonekanaje.

Ikiwa watu wawili au zaidi kwenye biashara yako watatumia mfumo mmoja kufanya kazi ile ile kila wiki, programu maalum ya wavuti inaweza kuwa nafuu kuliko miaka ya kazi ya mikono.

## Kinachobaki sawa kwenye vifurushi vyote

Kila kazi huanza na pendekezo lililoandikwa na upeo uliokubaliwa. Unapaswa kujua unacholipa kabla kazi kuanza. Marekebisho, ugavi wa maudhui, na gharama za wahusika wengine zinapaswa kutajwa wazi.

Malipo hufanywa kwa kila kazi. Hakuna malipo ya moja kwa moja wala kufungua kiotomatiki. Maelezo ya Buy Goods, benki, na Send Money yako kwenye ukurasa wa malipo.

## Jinsi ya kuchagua kwa dakika moja

Andika sentensi moja: Tovuti hii inamsaidia ______ kufanya ______.

Ikiwa sentensi inaishia na wasiliana nami, anza na Starter. Ikiwa inaishia na kuelewa na kuomba bei, angalia Business. Ikiwa inaishia na nunua na upokee oda, angalia Commerce. Ikiwa inaishia na kusimamia mchakato, angalia Custom.

## Hatua inayofuata

Tumia kitufe cha Start a project kwenye tovuti hii, au tuma ujumbe wa WhatsApp kwa 0705 023 432 ukiwa na sentensi yako moja. Utapata ushauri wazi, si mauzo ya shinikizo.
